notes:
TV has an optional "Video mode" now (Settings > TV, off by default) - plays the actual video from TV channels instead of just audio.

"Import favorites" now also accepts M3U/M3U8 playlists, not just a JSON export.

EQ presets finally explain what they do, plus two new ones: Film Music and Live Commentary.

Fixed: the update downloader could hang forever on a stuck/paused download - now times out cleanly after 5 minutes.
